record.original_question: For n > m > 1, let S(m, n) mean that every n-fold self-joining whose projections to all m-dimensional faces of X^n equal mu^m is trivial, that is, equal to mu^n, and let S_n denote S(n - 1, n). How are the odd properties S_{2n-1} related to one another?

evidence.quote: Говорим, что действие Ψ принадлежит классу S(m, n), n > m > 1 (или обладает свойством S(m, n)), если всякое cамоприсоединение порядка n > 2 такое, что все проекции на m-мерные грани куба X^n равны µ^m, является тривиальным, т.е. совпадает с мерой µ^n, произведением n копий меры µ. Далее используем обозначение S_n = S(n − 1, n), n > 2.
Q8. Как связаны между собой нечетные свойства S2n−1?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu)$ be a standard probability space and let $\Psi$ be a measure-preserving action of a group on $(X,\mu)$. For integers $n>m>1$, an $n$-fold self-joining of $\Psi$ is a $\Psi^{\otimes n}$-invariant probability measure on $X^n$ whose one-dimensional marginals all equal $\mu$. Write $\mu^k$ for the product measure of $k$ copies of $\mu$ on $X^k$. Say that $\Psi$ has property $S(m,n)$ if every $n$-fold self-joining $\nu$ of $\Psi$ such that the projection of $\nu$ onto every $m$-dimensional coordinate face of $X^n$ equals $\mu^m$ is necessarily the trivial joining $\mu^n$. For $n>2$ set $S_n := S(n-1,n)$.

Determine the logical implications and relations among the odd properties $S_{2n-1}$ ($n\geq 2$); in particular, for which pairs of positive integers $k<\ell$ (with $k,\ell$ both of the form $2n-1$) does $S_k$ imply $S_\ell$, or $S_\ell$ imply $S_k$, and which of these implications can fail?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem about the interrelation among the odd joining properties $S_{2n-1}$ in ergodic theory. Web search returned general references to Ryzhikov's work on minimal self-joinings and mixing of higher orders, but no source establishes the full pattern of implications among the odd $S_{2n-1}$. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Minimal Self-Joinings, Bounded Constructions, and Weak Closure of Ergodic Actions
status_evidence.snippet: Disjointness of powers and minimal self-joinings for rank-one constructions.
status_evidence.claim: Related context on self-joinings but does not resolve relations among the odd properties $S_{2n-1}$.

status_evidence.title: Mixing, Rank, and Minimal Self-Joining of Actions with an Invariant Measure (Ryzhikov)
status_evidence.snippet: Foundational results on minimal self-joinings and higher-order mixing.
status_evidence.claim: Background on joining properties; no explicit determination of mutual implications among the odd $S_{2n-1}$.
